reference_status: Draft references; qualified bilingual review required. Concept checks are heuristics, not semantic acceptance.

cases.english: The robot uses an ultrasonic sensor to estimate its distance from an obstacle.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 机器人使用超声波传感器估计自身与障碍物之间的距离。

cases.english: The robot must not move while a person is inside the safety area.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 安全区域内有人时，机器人不得移动。

cases.english: The left wheel rotates faster than the right wheel.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 左轮的转速高于右轮。

cases.english: The sensor measures distance, not speed.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 该传感器测量的是距离，而不是速度。

cases.english: A lower proportional gain can reduce oscillation.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 降低比例增益可以减小振荡。

cases.english: The measured position differs from the target position.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 测量位置与目标位置不同。

cases.english: Stop the motor before disconnecting the encoder.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 断开编码器之前，先停止电机。

cases.english: An obstacle behind the robot is outside the front sensor field of view.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 机器人后方的障碍物不在前向传感器的视野内。

cases.english: The ESP32 communicates with the sensor using the I2C protocol.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: ESP32通过I2C协议与传感器通信。

cases.english: Pulse width modulation changes the average voltage applied to the motor.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 脉宽调制改变施加在电机上的平均电压。

cases.english: An interrupt service routine should execute as quickly as possible.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 中断服务程序应尽快执行。

cases.english: The FreeRTOS scheduler performs a context switch between tasks.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: FreeRTOS调度器在任务之间进行上下文切换。

cases.english: The FPGA design is written in VHDL and synthesised into logic resources.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: FPGA设计使用VHDL编写，并综合为逻辑资源。

cases.english: The MOSFET is driven by a pulse width modulated signal.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: MOSFET由脉宽调制信号驱动。

cases.english: Do not enable interrupts until initialisation is complete.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 初始化完成之前，不要使能中断。

cases.english: The task is blocked while it waits for a message.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 任务在等待消息时处于阻塞状态。

cases.english: The supply voltage is 3.3 volts, not 5 volts.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 电源电压是3.3伏，而不是5伏。

cases.english: A 10 kiloohm resistor limits the current.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 一个10千欧电阻限制电流。

cases.english: The capacitor stores charge rather than producing energy.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 电容器储存电荷，而不是产生能量。

cases.english: Increasing resistance decreases current when voltage stays constant.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 电压不变时，增大电阻会减小电流。

cases.english: The output frequency is 20 kilohertz.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 输出频率为20千赫。

cases.english: The duty cycle changes from 25 percent to 75 percent.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 占空比从25%变为75%。

cases.english: A negative voltage is measured relative to the reference node.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 负电压是相对于参考节点测得的。

cases.english: The diode conducts current in only one direction.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 二极管只允许电流沿一个方向流动。

cases.english: A convolutional neural network can perform image classification at the edge.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 卷积神经网络可以在边缘端进行图像分类。

cases.english: The validation data must remain separate from the training data.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 验证数据必须与训练数据分开。

cases.english: A high accuracy does not guarantee good performance on unseen data.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 高准确率并不能保证模型在未见数据上表现良好。

cases.english: The model has overfitted the training examples.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 模型过拟合了训练样本。

cases.english: Quantisation can reduce memory use but may change numerical accuracy.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 量化可以减少内存使用，但可能影响数值精度。

cases.english: Inference runs locally without sending data to a server.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 推理在本地运行，不会将数据发送到服务器。

cases.english: The device sends a message only when the temperature exceeds 30 degrees Celsius.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 只有温度超过30摄氏度时，设备才发送消息。

cases.english: A lost packet does not always mean that the connection has failed.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 丢失一个数据包并不总意味着连接已经失败。

cases.english: The battery should last for at least 12 hours.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 电池应至少持续供电12小时。

cases.english: The sensor wakes every 500 milliseconds.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 传感器每500毫秒唤醒一次。

cases.english: First read the value, then calculate the average.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 先读取数值，然后计算平均值。

cases.english: If the value is zero, skip this step.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 如果数值为零，就跳过这一步。

cases.english: The measured result is approximately 2.5 times the predicted value.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 测量结果约为预测值的2.5倍。

cases.english: This example explains why the earlier assumption was incorrect.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 这个例子解释了先前假设为何不正确。

cases.english: The first experiment succeeded, but the second experiment failed.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 第一次实验成功，但第二次实验失败。

cases.english: We will compare the two methods after the break.
cases.draft_reference_chinese: 休息之后，我们将比较这两种方法。
